title: Migrate evaluation datasets evidence logs and traces
description:
Purpose: Remove default AWS credential requirements from local evaluation artifact paths.

Owned scope:
- Reference dataset downloads.
- Evaluation root-cause evidence.
- Score-result log and trace uploads and downloads.
- Centralized authenticated dashboard-client use in evaluation paths.

Acceptance:
- Accuracy evaluation loads a stored dataset without AWS credentials.
- Feedback evaluation persists complete error evidence.
- Core-path tests make boto3.client for S3 raise and still pass.
- Transfer and checksum failures are visible and never produce partial-success fallbacks.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Kickoff: canonical agent /root/artifact_ticket_api is working in /Users/ryan.porter/Projects/Plexus-aws-login-free-evaluation on branch codex/aws-login-free-evaluation, based on 06d9af09a8bf5ed3cb25535fdeb06c0a14a1e3e2. Owned files are the local evaluation dataset, root-cause evidence, score-result log, trace, and centralized dashboard-client storage call sites plus their behavior tests. Dependency boundary: this lane consumes the shared authenticated dashboard client and GraphQLArtifactStore interfaces; it does not change artifact-ticket API, CLI authentication, procedure persistence, optimizer storage, or consumer work outside local evaluation paths.
